backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods or logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file mapping frontend source paths to their descriptive summaries.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens, light/dark theme variables, and core layout defaults.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML template mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with root layout and all page routes for the app.
frontend/src/components/registration/Reg: Reusable registration form wrapper providing hero section, card layout, alerts, and content slot.
frontend/src/components/registration/val: Client-side validation helpers for required fields, email, phone, and file size checks.
frontend/src/components/site/LiveChatBut: Floating WhatsApp chat button linking to a preset greeting message.
Footer with logo, navigation links, services list, social icons, and copyright block.
Sticky header with logo, desktop navigation, and mobile hamburger menu.
Page layout wrapping header, outlet content, footer, and live chat button.
frontend/src/components/site/TrustSectio: Renders a grid of trust-focused cards using icons and descriptive text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks with no functionality yet.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays mission, vision, and core values with icon-based sections and structured content.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation and static contact information.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with hero messaging, sector listings, benefits, and trust indicators.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Renders a privacy policy page with sections describing data collection, usage, and security using cards and styled content.
frontend/src/pages/register/ClientRegist: Implements a client registration form with validation, state management, and submission handling within a reusable form shell.
frontend/src/pages/register/FarmerRegist: React page implementing a farmer registration form with validation, state handling, and submission UI using shared registration components.
frontend/src/pages/register/VendorRegist: React page for vendor registration including form validation, file upload handling, and submission logic with shared layout components.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Displays a services overview with six service categories, each with icons, descriptions, and features, along with a hero section.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders a terms of service page containing sections on acceptance, usage rules, accounts, and intellectual property.
frontend/src/pages/WhyChooseUsPage.tsx: Shows reasons to choose the company and supporting stats, using icons, grids, and descriptive sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and layout utilities with plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing site goals, branding guidelines, required pages, features, and known issues for GARUDAYA's corporate website.
